src/mlframe/data/datasets/replay.py::rep.note: Public offline API of the replay module (listed in __all__): it rebuilds the bed behind one stored result cell and refuses a record without dataset_seed (04-F30). No production code reads results files back yet, so it has no caller; wiring it to a results loader is a separate feature. Accepted as a documented entry point.

src/mlframe/feature_selection/filters/_o.note: Reference oracle for the lean production twin _build_degree_candidate_matrix: the production path (hybrid_orth_mi_adaptive_degree_fe) builds the candidate matrix directly, and the tests in test_adaptive_degree_lean_host_matrix.py and test_adaptive_degree_cells_on_device.py compare that lean output to this list-based builder cell for cell. It has no production caller by design, and it enforces nothing that production relies on; the equivalence is pinned by those tests.
